text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Bank of Bahrain posts a 4.4 million dinar net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Bahrain says to maintain its financial and banking standing in the Gulf.
- Crown Prince Sheikh Hamad hopes to boost military cooperation with Pakistan.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states should end their disputes with Iraq and Iran, South Africa's former foreign minister says.
- Bahrain's duty free market to raise its capital to two million dinars from 1.5 million dinars.
